# Upload Photos To Shared Album

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Uploads the given photos to the shared photos album.

## Syntax

~~~~text
uploadPhotos(photos: <#Variable#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
uploadPhotos(photos: Clipboard)
~~~~
